# `observe` operations

The exact fields each `observe.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can, or, for an HTTP call with no token on a single-user server, the install's own ([which ops](../http-api.md#request)); see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `observe.crystallize`

Mark a session's pending observations ready for extraction into memories (queues only).

`POST /v1/observe.crystallize` · MCP `loom_observe_crystallize` · role `writer` · idempotent

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The session or conversation the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `max_observations` | `int` | `500` | At most this many pending observations of the session are marked ready, oldest first. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enqueued` | `int` | How many observations were marked `crystallize:ready` for the extraction worker; 0 when the session had none pending. |
| `session_id` | `str` | The session or conversation the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |

## `observe.record`

Record one tool observation (input, output, files, error) into the episodic plane; no LLM call.

`POST /v1/observe.record` · MCP `loom_observe_record` · role `writer` · idempotent

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `agent` | `str` | required | The writing or reading agent; `'-'` or `'*'` means any agent where the op allows it. |
| `user_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The end user the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The session or conversation the row belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `run_id` | `str` | `'-'` | The agent run (task scope) the call belongs to; `'-'` for none. |
| `tool_name` | `str` | required | Name of the tool that ran; it picks the observation `kind` by substring match. |
| `tool_input` | `dict[str, Any] \| list[Any] \| str \| int \| float \| bool \| None` | `None` | Arbitrary JSON forwarded by the hook; stringified + truncated, never executed. |
| `tool_output` | `dict[str, Any] \| list[Any] \| str \| int \| float \| bool \| None` | `None` | What the tool returned; stringified and cut to 800 characters in the narrative. |
| `file_paths` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Merged with paths sniffed from the input/narrative. |
| `error` | `str \| None` | `None` | Present iff the call failed; reclassifies the observation kind to `error`. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Extra tags added after the server's own (`observation`, the kind, file basenames); at most 32 tags are kept in all. |
| `observation_date` | `str` | `''` | ISO YYYY-MM-DD stamped as valid_at; empty = leave NULL. |
| `action_type` | `str` | `''` | The client's own action class (file_read, command_run, …), added as an `action:<type>` tag. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Client context (project, repo, event); accepted, not stored. |
| `observed_at` | `str` | `''` | The moment the tool ran, so a capture posted later is dated when it happened. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `memory_key` | `str` | Key of the episodic row, `obs:<session_id>:<hash prefix>`; a re-fired hook for the same call gets the same key. |
| `memory_id` | `str` | Always empty: the row's id is assigned by the table and not read back. |
| `kind` | `str` | file_edit / command_run / error / web_fetch / file_read / tool_use. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | The tags stored on the row (at most 32). |
| `file_paths` | `list[str]` | File paths stored on the row: the ones sent plus those found in the input and narrative; empty for a self-referential call. |
| `content_sha256` | `str` | Hash of the stored observation value (kind, tool, narrative, paths, error). |
| `tool_name` | `str` | What the row holds, on the ledger as out_tool_name / out_has_error / out_narrative_chars — an observation with a 40-char narrative is a tool name, not an observation. |
| `has_error` | `bool` | True when `error` was non-empty (always False for a self-referential call). |
| `narrative_chars` | `int` | Length of the stored narrative in characters (at most 2000). |
| `skipped_reason` | `str` | Why the row was stored content-less: "self_referential" (the tool was loom itself or a harness meta tool), "blacklisted" (the content matched a blacklist pattern); "" otherwise. |
